messages:
Nina Rao: Escalation from Support: Cygnus trial stuck on onboarding. UI shows 'verifying org' and embedding ingest returns 403. Trial ends in 7 days. Opening for CS high touch. :rotating_light:

support-bot: Ticket #6120 created by Support - user=cygnus_trial, error=403 on POST /v1/embeddings, attempts=3, assigned=@Dylan Park.

Dylan Park: Quick repro: customer accidentally used production API key in sandbox flow. Auth layer rejects due to org_id mismatch: `403 - token_org=cygnus_prod_214 vs expected org=org_214`. They accepted a temp sandbox key and saw one success.

Marco Silva: Options: rotate keys (recommended) or apply temporary routing alias for up to 12h to let them finish onboarding. If CS requests live traffic, I can push a routing rule with TTL and auto-rollback. Example: `allow_ingest_if org_alias=="cygnus-214" ttl=43200`.

Nina Rao: Comms plan: 1) 3pm PT sync today to explain cause + workaround, 2) SE enablement session tomorrow to walk key rotation and SCIM mapping, 3) Confirm rotation and close loop, 4) Offer one-time trial extension/credit if impacted. I'll own customer comms and send draft for review.

Dylan Park: Marking ticket P1 while onboarding blocked. Updated zendesk: https://zendesk.example/ticket/6120. I'll attach logs and proposed steps.

Marco Silva: I'll stand by for the sync and have the routing PR ready if needed. Will include rollback plan.

Nina Rao: Internal task list: - Draft customer email (Nina) - AE renewal touch (Dylan) - SE standby + routing PR (Marco) - Playbook update (Dylan). Reminders set for 24h/72h.

Dylan Park: Customer confirmed 3pm PT works and accepted sandbox key for testing. Aiming to resolve before trial ends. :thumbsup:
